blocking_requirement: Verify the old-design replay implementation is isolated from census inclusion and exactly reproduces the original 88 selected announcement_ids on a dry replay fixture before real collection.
why_exact_prequery_replay_is_impossible: The original selection algorithm consumes the full per-window deduped/triaged/development-universe candidate pool and then applies SHA256(announcement_id) ordering, at-most-one-security diversity, and a six-row cap. The frozen 88 selected rows are only the output of that operation. Without the omitted pre-cap rows, the selection input cannot be reconstructed, so exact reproduction of the 88 selected IDs is not independently testable offline.
invalid_shortcuts_rejected: Treating the original 88 selected rows as the replay input, because that makes the replay tautological and cannot test censoring semantics.
Using the window-level candidate/development-universe counts without candidate identities, because counts cannot determine SHA256 ordering or per-security diversity.
Issuing CNINFO queries during validator execution while claiming real_source_queries_executed=false.
Weakening exact-88 replay to a synthetic-only algorithm self-test without a frozen contract clarification.
nonblocking_validation_that_remains_poss: 730-day inclusive date geometry and 105 deterministic transport partitions.
Frozen collector/triage/classifier blob checks and 18-term registry check.
Synthetic old-selection algorithm invariance and cap/diversity tests.
Temporal provenance boundary check through 2024-12-30 with 2024-12-31 available as a later frozen joint session.

proposed_two_phase_gate: Phase A, before any real query: static/offline validator must PASS all geometry, frozen-blob, authorization, safety, temporal, census-no-cap, and synthetic old-selection semantics checks.

Phase B, after source discovery has produced the census candidate pool but before H1/H3 attribution or terminal scientific classification: exact old-design replay must reproduce all 88 frozen selected announcement_ids; any mismatch makes the expansion TECHNICALLY_BLOCKED and H1/H3 results inadmissible.
